title: Important Logs
description: Replaces Payment Logs (deleted): routine triage without Explore — traceId/userId trails plus errors, bookings, webhooks, scheduler/DLQ and meetings streams. Home folder: Cogito — one folder holds boards and alert rules.

panels.title: Request trail (traceId)
panels.description: Healthy is a full request chain for the pasted traceId, and on gaps or error lines copy that traceId into the Errors panel to find the failing RPC.

panels.title: User trail (userId)
panels.description: Healthy is only expected booking and request lines for the pasted userId, and on error bursts filter further by traceId to isolate the failing request.

panels.title: Errors (rpc_error / request_error)
panels.description: Healthy is zero lines, and on any hit open the traceId from the log line in the Request trail panel to find the failing path.

panels.title: Bookings (created + failures)
panels.description: Healthy is a steady booking_created stream with no failure lines, and on any expire_booking_failed or release_hold_failed or meeting_finalize_failed hit open its traceId to decide retry versus manual fix.

panels.title: Webhooks
panels.description: Healthy is webhook_received lines with no failure actions, and on any signature or timestamp or missing_reference or dead_letter or processing_error hit verify the provider secret and replay the event from the dead-letter payload.

panels.title: Scheduler and DLQ
panels.description: Healthy is zero scheduler_job_failed and scheduler_dlq_job lines, and on any hit check the Delivery DLQ fresh depth then rerun or drain the named job.

panels.title: Meetings (Meet failures + fallback)
panels.description: Healthy is zero google_meet_create_failed and meeting_failed_attempt and meeting_manual_fallback lines, and on any hit verify Google credentials and quota then confirm the manual fallback link reached the tutor and student.
